description: This PHP file defines a function get_body() that prepares data for rendering an HTML template within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It sets up language labels, default values, TinyMCE editor configurations, and fetches a specific template.

methods.name: get_body
methods.description: Prepares and returns the HTML content for a form field, setting language labels, default values, TinyMCE configuration, and fetching the correct template.
